items.title: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) Agrees $4.2 Billion Refinery Deal To Refocus Its Footprint
items.summary: Marathon Petroleum (NYSE:MPC) agreed to sell its St. Paul Park and Mandan refineries and related assets to CVR Energy for US$4.2b. The transaction includes associated midstream and marketing operations that support the two upper Midwest refinery sites. The move reduces Marathon Petroleum's refining footprint in the northern U.S. while sharpening its focus on Gulf Coast operations.
